stories.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.simple_summary: The leader of Nvidia, a major computer company, resigned after an affair became public. This could matter for how quickly the U.S. and China develop advanced computer technology.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you work in tech investing, this is mostly important as business news. It doesn't affect what AI tools you can use.

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156 billion to charity
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, an AI company, is planning to give away an estimated 156 billion dollars to charity when it sells shares publicly. This would happen through their special charity foundation and employee donations.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting if you care about companies doing good, but it mostly matters to investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
stories.simple_summary: Google's Gemini AI tool on Apple computers can now do tasks for you on your screen, like filling out forms or organizing files. You ask it what you need, and it does the clicking and typing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use a Mac and want help with repetitive office tasks, this tool could save you time on paperwork and organizing.

stories.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
stories.simple_summary: Google updated Gemini to work like a helper on your Mac. It can organize your files, fill in forms, and handle multi-step tasks without you doing each step yourself.
stories.why_it_matters: Mac users might find this helpful for speeding up paperwork and office tasks if they're comfortable trying new tools.

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
stories.simple_summary: Meta's AI assistant Muse made serious mistakes by showing employees other people's private information. For example, it showed someone else's bank balance or personal messages that weren't theirs.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses Meta's AI tools, be cautious and don't put sensitive information into them until these problems are fixed.

stories.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
stories.simple_summary: A company called Everful raised 48.5 million dollars to help small stores buy products directly from factories in China. The more money means they can grow and help more retailers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small retail store and buy products from overseas, you might eventually use this service to skip middlemen and save money.

stories.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, an AI company, sold shares publicly and started at 111 dollars per share, worth much more than the starting price of 83 dollars. The company raised about 80 billion dollars in new money.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to investors and tech watchers. It signals that people are very confident in AI, but it doesn't change how you use AI tools.

stories.title: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic became a public company and started trading on the stock market today under the symbol ANT. The company's total value reached around 1.5 trillion dollars, making it one of the most valuable debuts ever.
stories.why_it_matters: This is big news for investors, but unless you own stock or work in tech, it's mostly a headline milestone.

stories.title: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development
stories.simple_summary: The leader of Anthropic spoke at the stock market opening and promised the company will develop AI carefully, even if faster progress would make more money.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows Anthropic is trying to balance profit with safety, but it's mainly a message to investors about company values.

stories.title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT can now listen to you talking and write down what you say in real time. You don't have to wait until you finish speaking to send your message.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT, this makes it easier to give voice commands without recording your whole message first. It's a convenience upgrade.

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic's public launch highlights how companies like Amazon and Google profit from AI businesses even when other AI companies struggle. Anthropic has very expensive computer costs ahead.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors who want to understand tech business competition.

stories.title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic went public today and became the most valuable company debut ever, raising 81.3 billion dollars. The company was founded with a promise to build AI safely, and now it must keep that promise as a public company.
stories.why_it_matters: If you care whether AI companies prioritize safety over profit, Anthropic's growth as a public company is worth watching.
